title: Query Zoho CRM in Claude Using MCP (No More Excel Exports) #Shorts
description:
Stop exporting CRM deals to Excel for weekly pipeline reviews. Connect Claude directly to Zoho CRM using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to query live bottlenecks in plain English.

1. Configure the Zoho MCP server connector in your Claude desktop or enterprise environment using your CRM API scopes.
2. Write a natural language prompt in Claude: 'Show me all deals in Zoho CRM stuck in Negotiation for over 14 days and summarize the next steps.'
3. Claude fetches the live CRM data instantly via MCP, bypassing manual exports and reports.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM COQL / Records API via MCP
- endpoint: https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v2.1/coql
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.deals.READ,ZohoCRM.coql.READ
- docs: https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v2.1/coql.html

Code (json) - Claude Desktop configuration file (claude_desktop_config.json):
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "zoho-crm": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/your-custom-zoho-mcp-server/index.js"],
      "env": {
        "ZOHO_CLIENT_ID": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
        "ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
        "ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN": "YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN",
        "ZOHO_API_DOMAIN": "https://www.zohoapis.com"
      }
    }
  }
}

lines.say: Sales managers waste hours building pivot tables and VLOOKUPs simply to identify which high-value deals are stuck in negotiation.

lines.say: In Zoho API Console, select Self Client, enter scopes like Zoho CRM modules deals read, and generate your refresh token.

screen.heading: Zoho API Console
screen.tip: Use Self Client to specify scopes and generate a grant and refresh token

lines.say: Open your Claude Desktop config file, and add your Zoho CRM custom MCP runner command with your credentials.

lines.say: Restart Claude, then ask in plain English: show all deals stuck in Negotiation over fourteen days with next steps.

messages: Show all deals stuck in Negotiation over 14 days and summarize next steps.

1. Al Noor Trading ($45,000) - 18 days stalled. Next step: Final procurement sign-off.
2. Apex Global ($62,000) - 21 days stalled. Next step: Schedule executive sponsor review.
